data_status: Previously inspected 2022-09-30 to 2023-09-29 sample; NO untouched test available
hypothesis_selection: Fixed defaults, no optimization. Variants and exit alternatives on TRAIN/VALIDATION only. Freeze before second-phase returns; all final-period readings labelled replication.

gates.sample_floor_note: 20 active day clusters is a minimum for reporting a resampled interval, not a universal adequate trade count or proof of edge. Precision and independent period evidence still required.
gates.multiplicity_note: Bonferroni budget 70 covers 14 base hypotheses and declared variants/exits. Exploratory features are not confirmatory tests.

variants: One economically justified variant per old family plus target 1.5R and hold 20m exits; new-family threshold multipliers 0.8 and 1.2; no combinations. All development only.
exit_research: frozen structural target when directionally valid
signal_event_study: Unique causal setups at next-minute open; 5/15/30 minute forward mid-price returns and same-path cost deductions. Overlapping events are dependent and are NOT executable profits or validation evidence. Bearish VWAP loss included only here.
regime: Research classifier v2 with explicit eligibility, evaluated separately from unchanged v1 controls. UNCERTAIN is NO NEW TRADE.
orb_decomposition: Fixed economic bins plus train-only terciles. Chronological group associations are descriptive; no selected filter from replication-period correlations.
portfolio: Aligned daily returns including zeros, drawdown correlation and setup-time overlap. Undefined correlations remain null. Independently funded simulations are not a shared portfolio.
shadow: Only quantitative gate passing strategies eligible; no automatically created config, service restart or broker mutation.
live: Independent untouched evidence, live feature/execution parity and prospective shadow evidence mandatory. No live enablement during research.
